tagline.en: Interrupt a podcast, ask out loud, keep listening.
tagline.zh: 用语音打断播客，随口提问接着听。

summary.en: AsideFM is a podcast player you can talk back to: interrupt an episode to ask by voice, keep the conversation going, and resume from a complete sentence.
summary.zh: AsideFM 是一个可以插话的播客播放器：听到好奇的地方开口提问，AI 结合前文回答，聊完从完整的一句话接着听。

coverAlt.en: Aside — Follow your curiosity, ask anytime.

role.zh: 工程师 · 产品创造者 · 写作者

bio.en: Builds systems that help people and teams do complex work with less friction — from release platforms used by thousands of engineers to AI tools and independent products.
bio.zh: 打造让个人和团队更顺畅地完成复杂工作的系统——从数千名工程师使用的发布平台，到 AI 工具和独立产品。

body.en: Start with a few minutes of audio — historical interviews and presidential addresses are ready to try.
body.zh: 先留几分钟——历史访谈、总统演讲、鲁迅的小说，都可以直接试听。

body.en: When a thought comes to mind, interrupt the episode and jump into the conversation by voice.
body.zh: 听到有想法的地方，直接用语音打断，加入对话。

body.en: Keep the conversation going as long as you like, then resume from a complete sentence.
body.zh: 想聊多久都行，聊完从完整的一句话接着往下听。
